frozen_unix_note: written before any test prediction was produced; do not edit after test evaluation starts
split: test (494 samples of the published DeformFieldBench split; objects disjoint from train/val)
checkpoint_rule: each run's best_material.pt = epoch with the lowest validation standardized MAE during joint training; no test-based selection, no re-training, no hyper-parameter change after this file

native_space_main_table.law_mean_reference: GT law + train-set law mean; privileged diagnostic, not deployable

statistics: 3-seed mean +- sd; object-level paired bootstrap (2000 draws) per seed for VJEPA2L_C vs DINOv3_C, C vs D, B vs C, Static vs VJEPA2L_B
decision_threshold: 2% relative improvement (engineering threshold, pre-registered in the project)
